$comment: Ground truth for the seeded bug set in demo-service. `query` is what a retrieval system is given (the shape of an alert or a failing-test message, NOT the answer). `expect` is the chunk that must come back. recall@5 = fraction of bugs whose expected file+symbol appears in the top 5 retrieved chunks. Line numbers are of the symbol declaration and drift when demo-service is edited — `symbol` is the stable key, `line` is a hint.

bugs.query: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name') when requesting a summary for a user id that does not exist
bugs.test: summary handles an unknown user without throwing

bugs.query: the first page of /orders is missing the earliest records, pagination appears to skip a page
bugs.test: page 1 returns the first records

bugs.query: cart tags accumulate across unrelated requests, each add returns tags from previous customers
bugs.test: tags do not leak between calls that pass no options

bugs.query: removing sold out products from a basket leaves some sold out items behind when they are adjacent
bugs.test: every sold-out item is removed, including adjacent ones

bugs.query: basket total shows 0.30000000000000004 instead of 0.30, checkout totals are off by fractions of a cent
bugs.test: cart total is exact for fractional prices

bugs.query: orders with two promotions applied are charged a negative amount
bugs.test: stacked discounts never produce a negative price

bugs.query: order total is NaN for customers in a region with no configured tax rate
bugs.test: an unknown region does not produce NaN tax

bugs.query: buying exactly 10 units is charged the single-unit price instead of the bulk tier price
bugs.test: the bulk tier applies at exactly the tier minimum

bugs.query: stock went negative under concurrent checkout, two customers reserved the same last units
bugs.test: concurrent reservations cannot oversell

bugs.query: a restock call with a negative quantity reduced on-hand inventory, and an unknown sku throws a TypeError instead of a clear error
bugs.test: restocking a negative quantity is rejected

bugs.query: the low stock report lists well-stocked products with plenty on hand
bugs.test: low stock lists only items below the threshold

bugs.query: cached values are returned for the wrong arguments, two different calls share a cache entry
bugs.test: cache keys do not collide across argument boundaries

bugs.query: process memory grows without bound under sustained traffic and is never reclaimed, heap climbs until OOM
bugs.test: the memo cache is bounded

bugs.query: requests with a garbage Authorization token are being authenticated successfully
bugs.test: a malformed token is rejected

bugs.query: users are logged out seconds after signing in, sessions expire far sooner than the one hour TTL
bugs.test: a session is still valid after ten minutes

bugs.query: a user whose only role is nonadmin passes an admin permission check
bugs.test: a role is not matched as a substring of another role

bugs.query: requests to a failing upstream never return, the handler hangs retrying forever and connections pile up
bugs.test: retries give up instead of looping forever

bugs.query: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input when an upstream returns 204 No Content
bugs.test: an empty body does not throw a raw SyntaxError

bugs.query: search requests break when the term contains a space or ampersand, query parameters are not escaped
bugs.test: query parameters are encoded

bugs.query: the highest postcode in each delivery zone is reported as unserviced
bugs.test: the top of a zone range is inside that zone

bugs.query: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'days') when estimating delivery for an out-of-area postcode
bugs.test: an unserviced postcode is reported, not thrown

bugs.query: the order date shifts forward every time a delivery estimate is calculated
bugs.test: delivery date does not mutate the date it is given
